title: Binary Search Index
statement: Given sorted distinct integers and a target, print the index of target or -1 if absent.

io_format.input_description: Line 1: n. Line 2: n sorted ints. Line 3: target.

hints.text: Maintain lo/hi pointers on index range.

reference_solutions.python:
import sys
data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
n = int(data[0])
arr = list(map(int, data[1:1+n]))
t = int(data[1+n])
lo, hi = 0, n-1
ans = -1
while lo <= hi:
    mid = (lo+hi)//2
    if arr[mid] == t:
        ans = mid
        break
    if arr[mid] < t:
        lo = mid+1
    else:
        hi = mid-1
print(ans)
